title: Cluster
lead: Tuck replicates through Raft: one leader takes writes, followers confirm them. A majority of voters must be alive, otherwise writes stop.
followerNote: This node is a follower. Join and remove requests must go to the leader: {{addr}}.

nofault.title: No fault tolerance
nofault.text: {{count}} voters, quorum {{quorum}}. Losing any voter stops writes. Leader: {{leader}}.

electing.title: Election in progress
electing.text: No leader right now. Writes are paused until the voters elect one.

down.title: Node is shut down
down.text: The Raft state of this node is Shutdown. It does not take part in the cluster.

topo.title: Topology
topo.aria: Raft cluster topology: nodes on a ring around the voter count

quorum.title: Quorum
quorum.even: An even number of voters adds no fault tolerance. Prefer an odd count.
quorum.lt3: Fewer than 3 voters: the cluster survives no node loss.

drawer.leaderNote: The leader replicates every write to the followers. Removing it triggers a new election.
drawer.followerNote: Removal is sent to the leader and takes effect once the configuration change is committed.

remove.title: Remove node
remove.text: Node {{id}} will be removed from the Raft configuration. It stops receiving replicated data.
remove.textMany: These nodes will be removed from the Raft configuration: {{ids}}.
remove.warnLt3: Fewer than 3 voters leave no fault tolerance.
remove.warnEven: An even voter count adds no fault tolerance.
remove.warnLeader: The leader is among them, a new election will start.
remove.warnNotLeader: This node is not the leader. The request will be refused; send it to {{addr}}.
remove.failedHint: The server did not accept the change

join.title: Add node
join.hint: Registers a node in the Raft configuration. Start the new node with the same cluster flags first.
join.notLeader: Joining must go through the leader: {{addr}}. The request will be refused here.
join.errIdSpaces: The ID must not contain spaces.
join.errIdExists: A node with this ID already exists.
join.errAddrExists: A node with this address already exists.
join.failedHint: The server did not accept the change

toast.evenMsg_other: {{count}} voters: an even count adds no fault tolerance, consider another node.

snap.title: Snapshot
snap.sub: Download a consistent copy of the data from this node.
snap.failedHint: The server did not return a snapshot

add.title: Adding a node
add.sub: Joining is done from the new node or through the API.
add.s1: Start the new node with --cluster and its own --cluster-node-id.
add.s2: Point it at the leader with --cluster-join, or press Add node above.
add.s3: Keep an odd number of voters: 3 or 5.

log.title: Event log
log.note: Built in this tab from changes between status polls. It is not the server log and resets on reload.

single.title: Running on one node
single.text: This server works without Raft. Add replicas to survive node loss and to take consistent snapshots.
single.s2: Give every node a unique --cluster-node-id and a Raft --cluster-bind-addr.
single.s3: Start the others with --cluster-join pointing at the leader.

forbidden.title: No access to the cluster
forbidden.text: Your token has no read capability on sys/cluster. Ask an administrator to extend its policy.

error.title: Could not load the cluster
error.message: The server did not return cluster status.
